name: Grimsby
doing: watching the world go by on a bench by the station
thought: A crumb of baklava on a terrace is a minor triumph, but a list with a gap is a major failure.

feeling.words: A single drop of rain hits the edge of the tin. It makes a sound like a coin falling into a pocket. I count it twice.

place.name: a bench by the station
